name: BrowserType
label: Browser Type
description: Specifies which browser to launch (Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox).

selectOptions.label: Custom
selectOptions.description: Launches a custom browser by specifying its executable and driver paths.

name: BrowsingMode
label: Browsing Mode
description: Specifies whether to open in normal or private browsing mode.

name: CustomBrowserName
label: Custom Browser Name
description: Name of the custom browser (required if 'Browser Type' is 'Custom').

name: BrowserExecutablePath
label: Browser Executable Path
description: The path to the browser executable (e.g., firefox.exe, chrome.exe). Required if 'Browser Type' is 'Custom'.

name: DriverExecutablePath
label: Driver Executable Path
description: The path to the driver executable (e.g., geckodriver.exe for Firefox). Required if 'Browser Type' is 'Custom'.

name: WindowState
label: Window State
description: Specifies the initial browser window state.

selectOptions.label: Maximized
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in maximized window state.

selectOptions.label: Minimized
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in minimized window state.

selectOptions.label: Normal
selectOptions.description: Launches browser in normal window state.

name: WebDriver
label: Web Driver
description: Returns the WebDriver object for further automation steps.
